Rajjo Gujjar   is a comprehensive, feature-rich Discord bot built with Python that combines AI-powered
conversational capabilities with traditional Discord bot functionality. The bot leverages Large Language Model
LLM) integration via Ollama, provides music playback through Lavalink, includes moderation tools, fun games,
and maintains comprehensive logging capabilities through SQLite database integration.
Rajjo Gujjar  is designed as a playful, confident, and witty female assistant character that provides both
entertainment and utility functions for Discord servers. The bot maintains a consistent personality through
carefully crafted system prompts while offering comprehensive server management capabilities.Rajjo Gujjar   Discord Bot - Complete
